# git 2.54 `git help --config` vars that have no row in gitguard/rules.py, reviewed by hand.
# Each was checked for whether it can name a program or command line (=> EXEC row) or point git
# at another repo, host, path or trust root (=> REDIRECT row). Those got rows instead of a line here.
# Everything listed classifies UNKNOWN, which still WARNs on any value: nothing here is a silent pass.
# Format: the var as `git help --config` spells it, optionally `# reviewed: <reason>`. A var whose
# name matches tests/test_rules.py's _SUSPICIOUS regex must carry a reason.
